properties.description: Explicit package name, which may be different to the import path.
properties.name: rootPackageName

properties.description: Map from package name -> package alias.
properties.name: packageImportAliases

properties.description: Defines the pattern for how import paths should be constructed from the base import path and used module By default, the pattern is "{baseImportPath}/{module}" but can be overridden to support other patterns. for example you can use "{baseImportPath}/{module}/v2" which will replace {module} with the module name and {baseImportPath} with the base import path to compute the full path.
properties.name: importPathPattern

properties.description: Generate container types (arrays, maps, pointer output types etc.) for each resource. These are typically used to support external references.
properties.name: generateResourceContainerTypes

properties.description: The version of the Pulumi SDK used with this provider, e.g. 3. Used to generate doc links for pulumi builtin types. If omitted, the latest SDK version is used.
properties.name: pulumiSDKVersion

properties.description: Determines whether to make single-return-value methods return an output struct or the value.
properties.name: liftSingleValueMethodReturns

properties.description: When set, the code generator will use this name for the generated internal module instead of "internal" so that functionality within the module can be used by end users.
properties.name: internalModuleName

properties.description: Determines whether or not the code generator generates input (and output) types for all plain types, instead of for only types that are used as input/output types.
properties.name: generateExtraInputTypes

properties.description: Determines whether the code generator generates input (and output) types for all plain types, instead of for only types that are used as input/output types.
properties.name: omitExtraInputTypes

properties.description: Respect the Pkg.Version field for emitted code.
properties.name: respectSchemaVersion

properties.description: Blank imports that are emitted in the SDK so that `go mod tidy` does not remove the associated module dependencies from the SDK's go.mod.
properties.name: internalDependencies

properties.description:
Specifies how to handle generating a variant of the SDK that uses generics. Allowed values are the following:

- "none" (default): do not generate a generics variant of the SDK
- "side-by-side": generate a side-by-side generics variant of the SDK under the x subdirectory
- "only-generics": generate a generics variant of the SDK only
properties.name: generics
